retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, moody portrait featuring a central subject against a misty, low-contrast background with ultra-wide-spaced geometric typography spanning the horizontal center.
excludeWhen: sharp, clear background details are essential

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a male subject in a patterned open shirt, set against a heavily diffused, foggy background. The color palette is muted and cool-toned, with a clean, white geometric sans-serif title positioned horizontally across the mid-section of the frame using extreme letter-spacing.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject depth vs. misty background flatness
Intricate shirt pattern vs. minimalist typography
Horizontal text line vs. vertical subject posture
Cool-toned desaturation vs. warm skin undertones
coreInvariants: Centered horizontal text alignment at chest level

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, captured from the waist up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's direct gaze and the high-contrast white text spanning the width of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the patterned shirt, then scan horizontally across the wide-spaced text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the foggy, overcast sky and background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted greys and desaturated blues in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the typography and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm brown and tan tones in the skin and shirt pattern.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a compressed value range in the background to simulate fog.
paletteRestrictions: No deep blacks; shadows are lifted and matte

letterConstructionRules: Equal width distribution across the frame
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a centered horizontal bar
The 'E' has equal length horizontal strokes

composition.scale: Small to medium point size relative to frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme spacing to create a graphic line effect.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions and clean lines.
Modern, balanced sans-serif with excellent legibility at wide tracking.
Geometric open-source alternative with similar weight and structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a male subject in an open patterned shirt, standing in a thick, desaturated fog that obscures the background landscape. Apply a matte, low-contrast color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase text in a geometric sans-serif font across the center of the image. Set tracking to at least 800 to span the full width of the frame in white.

verificationChecks: Text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Letter spacing is wide enough to touch both edges of the frame.
Background is sufficiently misty to make white text pop.
Color palette remains desaturated and cool.

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on clothing
Do not use high-contrast black shadows
postGenerationChecks: Is the text color pure white?
Is the background detail sufficiently blurred/foggy?
Is the subject's skin tone natural despite the desaturation?
Does the text span the majority of the image width?
recipe.reuseFormula: Misty Portrait + Geometric Sans + Extreme Tracking = Atmospheric Minimalism
